# denote

> Portal and facade for audio-to-symbol tools (MIDI, chords, pitch from audio)


## Pages

- [denote](index.html.md): Portal and facade for audio-to-symbol tools (MIDI, chords, pitch from audio).
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;denote&#96;   | Denote — Portal and facade for audio-to-symbol tools.   |
- [denote](_autosummary/denote.html.md): Denote — Portal and facade for audio-to-symbol tools.
- [denote.align](_autosummary/denote.align.html.md): Align a symbolic score to a recording of the same music (audio-to-score sync).
- [denote.backends](_autosummary/denote.backends.html.md): Backend packages for denote. Each subpackage provides a config.py and adapter.py.
- [denote.backends.basic_pitch](_autosummary/denote.backends.basic_pitch.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for Basic Pitch (Spotify) — audio to MIDI transcription.       |
- [denote.backends.basic_pitch.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.basic_pitch.adapter.html.md): Adapter for Basic Pitch (Spotify) — audio to MIDI transcription.
- [denote.backends.basic_pitch.compat](_autosummary/denote.backends.basic_pitch.compat.html.md): Make basic-pitch importable and runnable against today’s dependencies.
- [denote.backends.basic_pitch.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.basic_pitch.config.html.md): Configuration for the Basic Pitch (Spotify) backend.
- [denote.backends.beat_this](_autosummary/denote.backends.beat_this.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for Beat This! — transformer beat and downbeat tracking.     |
- [denote.backends.beat_this.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.beat_this.adapter.html.md): Adapter for Beat This! — transformer beat and downbeat tracking.
- [denote.backends.beat_this.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.beat_this.config.html.md): Configuration for the Beat This! beat and downbeat tracking backend.
- [denote.backends.demucs_mlx](_autosummary/denote.backends.demucs_mlx.html.md): HTDemucs source separation on MLX (demucs-mlx), run in its own environment.
- [denote.backends.demucs_mlx.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.demucs_mlx.adapter.html.md): Adapter for demucs-mlx: HTDemucs on MLX, in its own environment (&#96;denote.isolated&#96;).
- [denote.backends.demucs_mlx.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.demucs_mlx.config.html.md): Configuration for the demucs-mlx (HTDemucs on MLX) separation backend.
- [denote.backends.librosa_beats](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_beats.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for librosa beat tracking.                   |
- [denote.backends.librosa_beats.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_beats.adapter.html.md): Adapter for librosa beat tracking.
- [denote.backends.librosa_beats.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_beats.config.html.md): Configuration for the librosa beat tracking backend.
- [denote.backends.librosa_key](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_key.html.md): librosa key estimation backend: Krumhansl-Schmuckler over mean CQT chroma.
- [denote.backends.librosa_key.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_key.adapter.html.md): Adapter for key estimation from librosa chroma and published key profiles.
- [denote.backends.librosa_key.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_key.config.html.md): Configuration for the librosa key estimation backend (the single source of its defaults).
- [denote.backends.librosa_pyin](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_pyin.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for librosa pYIN — probabilistic pitch estimation.   |
- [denote.backends.librosa_pyin.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_pyin.adapter.html.md): Adapter for librosa pYIN — probabilistic pitch estimation.
- [denote.backends.librosa_pyin.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.librosa_pyin.config.html.md): Configuration for the librosa pYIN backend.
- [denote.backends.pesto](_autosummary/denote.backends.pesto.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for PESTO — self-supervised pitch estimation (Sony CSL).   |
- [denote.backends.pesto.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.pesto.adapter.html.md): Adapter for PESTO — self-supervised pitch estimation (Sony CSL).
- [denote.backends.pesto.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.pesto.config.html.md): Configuration for the PESTO pitch backend.
- [denote.backends.roformer](_autosummary/denote.backends.roformer.html.md): RoFormer source separation (audio-separator), run in its own environment.
- [denote.backends.roformer.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.roformer.adapter.html.md): Adapter for RoFormer checkpoints via audio-separator, in its own environment.
- [denote.backends.roformer.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.roformer.config.html.md): Configuration for the RoFormer separation backend (audio-separator).
- [denote.backends.swift_f0](_autosummary/denote.backends.swift_f0.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for SwiftF0 — fast CNN pitch estimation on CPU (ONNX).   |
- [denote.backends.swift_f0.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.swift_f0.adapter.html.md): Adapter for SwiftF0 — fast CNN pitch estimation on CPU (ONNX).
- [denote.backends.swift_f0.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.swift_f0.config.html.md): Configuration for the SwiftF0 pitch backend.
- [denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs.html.md): torchaudio Hybrid Demucs source separation backend.
- [denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs.adapter.html.md): Adapter for torchaudio’s Hybrid Demucs bundles (&#96;HDEMUCS_HIGH_MUSDB_PLUS&#96; by default).
- [denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchaudio_hdemucs.config.html.md): Configuration for the torchaudio Hybrid Demucs separation backend.
- [denote.backends.torchcrepe](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchcrepe.html.md): | &#96;adapter&#96;   | Adapter for torchcrepe — GPU-accelerated pitch estimation.   |
- [denote.backends.torchcrepe.adapter](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchcrepe.adapter.html.md): Adapter for torchcrepe — GPU-accelerated pitch estimation.
- [denote.backends.torchcrepe.config](_autosummary/denote.backends.torchcrepe.config.html.md): Configuration for the torchcrepe backend.
- [denote.base](_autosummary/denote.base.html.md): Core types and result dataclasses for denote.
- [denote.compare](_autosummary/denote.compare.html.md): Compare a version of a piece with a reference: harmony and sound, on the same moments (denote#3).
- [denote.isolated](_autosummary/denote.isolated.html.md): Backends that run in their own Python environment, through &#96;ps.isolated&#96;.
- [denote.keys](_autosummary/denote.keys.html.md): Key estimation from pitch-class profiles (the Krumhansl-Schmuckler method).
- [denote.registry](_autosummary/denote.registry.html.md): Backend discovery, registration, and lazy loading.
- [denote.services](_autosummary/denote.services.html.md): Lazy mapping of backend names → ServiceHandle instances.
- [denote.translation](_autosummary/denote.translation.html.md): Parameter translation between normalized and native backend interfaces.
- [denote.util](_autosummary/denote.util.html.md): Audio loading (any layout to &#96;(channels, frames)&#96;), and chunked overlap-add for models
- [denote.workers](_autosummary/denote.workers.html.md): Worker files: model code that runs in a backend’s own environment (&#96;denote.isolated&#96;).
- [denote.workers.demucs_mlx_worker](_autosummary/denote.workers.demucs_mlx_worker.html.md): demucs-mlx worker: HTDemucs on Apple’s MLX, run in the &#96;demucs_mlx&#96; environment.
- [denote.workers.roformer_worker](_autosummary/denote.workers.roformer_worker.html.md): RoFormer worker: audio-separator’s RoFormer checkpoints, run in the &#96;roformer&#96; environment.
